This is with reference to our letter no. APL/SEC/57/2026-27/4 dated 29th May 2026, wherein it was 
informed that the 80th Annual General Meeting (“AGM”) of the Company is scheduled to be held on 
Thursday, 9 th July 2026 at 11:00 a.m. IST through video conference and/or other audio visual 
means. 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 34(1) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed the Notice convening the 80 th AGM and the Integrated 
Annual Report of the Company, including the Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report, 
for the financial year 2025-26. 
 
Further, the Notice of the AGM and the Integrated Annual Report of the Company for the 
financial year 2025 -26 is being sent through electronic mode to all those shareholders of 
the Company whose email addresses are registered with the Company /Registrar and Share 
Transfer Agent (“RTA”) /Depository Participant(s) and the physical copies of the same will be 
provided to the shareholders on request. For those shareholders who have not registered their 
email addresses, a letter providing the web link from where the Notice of the AGM and Integrated 
Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26 can be accessed is being sent. 
 
The Notice of the AGM along with the Integrated Annual Report for the financial year 2025 -26 is 
also uploaded on the Company’s website at https://www.asianpaints.com/AnnualReports.html and 
the website of National Securities Depository Limited at www.evoting.nsdl.com. 
 
You are requested to take the above information on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours truly, 
 
For ASIAN PAINTS LIMITED

RESPONSIBLE. 
RESILIENT. RADIANT.
At Asian Paints, every stroke of colour carries 
a deeper purpose - to transform spaces into 
expressions of joy, warmth and belonging. 
In FY 2025-26, we continued this journey 
with a renewed commitment to bringing joy 
to people’s lives. 
As India’s leading paint and décor brand 
and among the world’s foremost decorative 
coatings companies, we are constantly and 
responsibly reimagining how homes and 
spaces can inspire emotion and elevate 
everyday living while building the resilience 
to adapt, innovate and lead in a dynamic 
environment. Our radiance extends beyond 
our products - shaping experiences, 
enhancing lifestyles and building enduring 
connections with Millions of consumers.
Guided by our innovative spirit, we continue 
to embark on a journey that inspires us not 
only to transform living spaces but also to 
enrich lives.

RESPONSIBLE
Responsibility at Asian Paints extends 
beyond business, embedded in 
how we shape a sustainable and 
inclusive future. Our approach spans 
environmental stewardship, ethical 
governance and social transformation. 
From advancing green manufacturing 
practices and reducing environmental 
impact to strengthening ethical and 
governance frameworks, we are 
committed to building a business that 
is future-ready and accountable. At the 
same time, our St+art interventions 
offer a meaningful expression of 
responsibility, reimagining urban 
landscapes and transforming public 
spaces into vibrant expressions of 
community and creativity. 
RESILIENT
In a rapidly evolving market, 
resilience reflects Asian Paints’ 
tenacity to adapt, innovate 
and lead with confidence. 
Our enduring strength lies in our 
agility - empowering us to promptly 
respond to changing consumer 
aspirations, navigate competitive 
dynamics and continuously redefine 
industry benchmarks. Our focus 
on brand building and innovation 
remains central to this resilient 
mindset. By investing in cutting-edge 
solutions, expanding our product 
portfolio and strengthening our 
consumer connect, we continue to 
emerge stronger, sharper and more 
relevant with every change.
RADIANT
Radiance lies at the heart of 
everything we create through the 
celebration of colour and creativity. 
It adds life and meaning to spaces, 
pushing the boundaries of décor, 
offering consumers a rich universe 
of possibilities to express their 
individuality. From leveraging 
advanced colour systems like 
Chromacosm - the world's largest 
colour system, to pioneering premium 
décor offerings through Nilaya 
Anthology, we are shaping the future 
of interior aesthetics. Our innovations 
encompass platforms like the Glitz 
Guide, to new introductions across 
paint, waterproofing, lights and 
kitchen categories, spreading joy in 
every corner.

responsible practices into the way we operate, innovate and grow, while staying true to our purpose of bringing 
joy to people’s lives.
